vulkan_readback.decoder: Read little-endian uint32 pixels; R=bits 0-9, G=bits 10-19, B=bits 20-29, A=bits 30-31; scale UNORM channels to 8-bit RGBA.

device_screenshot.observed_screen: Original English safety disclaimer on black with thin purple horizontal strips above and below the text.

readback_screenshot_comparison.method: Crop the centered 1920x1080 16:9 viewport from the 2340x1080 device capture, then bilinear-resize to 1280x720.
readback_screenshot_comparison.interpretation: The decoded Vulkan guest-output readback visually matches the contemporaneous device screenshot after accounting for Android viewport scaling. This compares two views of the same renderer output; it is not an independent retail parity reference.

runtime.later_observation: At 17:57:59 the activity was still top-resumed, the process was alive, and the device screenshot remained byte-identical; no further renderer submits appeared after the file probes. The probes precede the stop but do not establish its cause.

related_language_selector_evidence.interpretation: A separate live Redmi capture confirms the original selector labels are readable on this renderer build. This frame-1026 readback is from the later safety disclaimer, after the language choice had already been retained.

limitations: This verifies one real post-selector retail guest frame on Mali through the Vulkan presenter; it does not establish race-scene output or complete visual parity.
The purple strips are visible in both the device screenshot and the renderer readback; their source draw, texture, or video-plane contract has not yet been isolated.
